verdict.rationale: Marqeta's MCP server description notes agents can query only a 'designated set' of Core API endpoints, implying some built-in scoping for agent access, and spend/velocity/merchant controls let admins constrain what a card (and by extension an agent-triggered transaction) can do. However, there is no documented mechanism for an AI-native user to actually issue or configure their own least-privilege API keys/credentials/scopes for an agent — the scoping evidence is about spend limits, not credential/permission scoping. Missing for 10: explicit API key/OAuth scope management for agents, documentation of configurable MCP server permission sets, and any user-facing UI/API for credential issuance with granular access control.
